dc.tagline: Digital twin: real building, fictional use
dc.provMeasuredBody: The 3D mesh (2025 aerial survey), terrain, orthophoto and building geometry come from official survey data (Geobasis NRW). Roads and pharmacy locations come from OpenStreetMap. The Confex building at Koelnmesse is real.
dc.provSyntheticBody: Caldova is a fictional company. Using the Confex as a logistics centre, the interior layout, the pharmacy names, tours, stock and reorders are a traceable generated model — no statement about Koelnmesse or about real pharmacies.
dc.provNote: What is measured is labelled measured. What is invented is labelled invented. No figure quietly changes sides.
dc.dayNote: One clock drives everything: the machinery in the logistics centre, the vehicles on the road and the time of day. The first wave rolls before the pharmacies open. Trucks (7.5 t) and vans are true to scale, 1:1 — from a distance only the ground glow and the markers help you find them. Positions and timings are to the model, within about 6 km of the trade fair.
dc.toursNote: Drop points sit at real pharmacy locations from OpenStreetMap but carry fictional names. Vehicles follow the real road network. Tours and customer relationships are a model.
dc.hallHint: The logistics centre is pulled apart above the roof along the process chain, from goods-in to the docks. The layout is synthetic, fitted to scale into the measured footprint.
dc.zoneNone: No zone selected. Click one in the 3D model — or click beside it to clear.

site.logistikzentrum: The Confex at Koelnmesse, opened 2024, here as the Caldova Logistics Centre. The building is real and comes from the official aerial survey; Caldova's use of it is invented.

mesh.heading: City model
mesh.note: Photogrammetric NRW 3D mesh from the aerial survey of 11 May 2025: the trade fair, Deutz, the Rhine and the old town as they look from the air. Finest resolution at the Confex and the cathedral.
mesh.attribution: 3D mesh: data source Land NRW (Geobasis NRW), 2025 aerial survey
